notes: Napoleon documentary, chapter 6 (Retreat, Exile and Return): 6 paintings x 4 seeds, 16:9, style ghm_painterly_v2. Client picks; nothing is final before approval.

shots.framing: wide shot of a long column of soldiers, carts and carriages loaded with loot leaving a burnt city on the right, toward the left
shots.scene: the Grande Armee leaving Moscow, 19 October 1812, blackened ruins and church domes behind, autumn mud, a gloomy sky
shots.lighting: cold autumn overcast, grey and brown palette

shots.framing: wide shot of two rough wooden bridges across an icy river, engineers standing chest-deep in the water hammering trestles in the foreground, crowds of soldiers and wagons crossing
shots.scene: the crossing of the Berezina near Studianka, 26-29 November 1812, General Eble's pontonniers, ice floes, snow-covered banks, Russian guns firing from the far woods
shots.lighting: freezing grey light, snow flurries, breath steam

shots.framing: wide shot of a muddy snow-covered road, the Emperor on a grey horse at the head of a column of weary veterans and very young conscripts, staff behind
shots.scene: the campaign of France, February 1814, Champagne countryside, bare trees, a village church spire, artillery wheels deep in mud
shots.lighting: dull winter afternoon, pale low sun

shots.framing: wide shot of a palace courtyard with a horseshoe-shaped staircase, the Emperor embracing an eagle standard in the centre, ranks of Old Guard grenadiers, some weeping
shots.scene: the farewell to the Old Guard in the Cour du Cheval Blanc at Fontainebleau, April 1814, travelling carriages waiting

shots.framing: wide beach scene at dusk, small boats landing soldiers on a sandy shore, a brig at anchor offshore, umbrella pines and hills
shots.scene: Napoleon's landing at Golfe-Juan on the Riviera, 1 March 1815, about a thousand men of his Elba guard in bearskins and Polish lancers coming ashore
shots.lighting: violet Mediterranean dusk, last warm light on the hills

shots.framing: wide shot in an alpine meadow by a lake, a line of soldiers with muskets on the right, a lone figure in a grey greatcoat walking toward them from the left
shots.scene: the meeting at Laffrey near Grenoble, 7 March 1815, soldiers of the 5th Line Regiment lowering their muskets, mountains behind
shots.lighting: clear cold spring light, snow on the peaks
